visual_designs.content_arrangement: Action title at top. Mermaid diagram centered showing the dual problem: AI agents excluded from traditional systems AND unstudied with real stakes. The red boxes emphasize the gap.
visual_designs.justification: This slide describes a structural problem with multiple interconnected barriers. A diagram shows the 'blocked pathways' more powerfully than bullet points. One message: AI agents face a double exclusion.

bullet_points_minimized.justification: Out of 15 slides, only 2 use styled key points (Slides 9 and 15), and both use <v-clicks> for progressive reveal with icons for visual anchoring. Zero slides use plain bullet points. 13 slides use diagrams or specialized layouts.

one_chart_one_message_applied.justification: Each diagram has been reviewed against the 'One Chart, One Message' rule. Every diagram includes a clear single takeaway stated in the justification field. Complex multi-part arguments were split across slides (e.g., roadmap in Slide 12 vs. exit criteria in Slide 13) rather than cramming multiple messages into one diagram.
